description:
The startup hint mentions ctrl+o for 'more' but doesn't mention the '!' for bash commands.

OBSERVED (Elixir - left):
'escape interrupt · ctrl+c/ctrl+d clear/exit · / commands · ? more'

EXPECTED (Node.js - right):
'escape interrupt · ctrl+c/ctrl+d clear/exit · / commands · ! bash · ctrl+o more'

The '! bash' hint should be added between '/ commands' and 'ctrl+o more'.
title: TUI-6: Missing '!' bash command hint in startup
